info.name: Tvarka ATK Tvarka ATK API API

description.content:
The canonical ATK API contract. ATK physical-reader and NFC ceremonies are the primary authentication and signing methods. Smart-ID and Mobile-ID are optional server-side methods under the same request, polling, webhook and metering model. Start with the [five-minute quickstart](https://atk.tvarka.pro/docs/quickstart/) or use the specialist [authentication](https://atk.tvarka.pro/docs/auth/) and [signing](https://atk.tvarka.pro/docs/sign/) references.
